cases.name: admission.core.json
cases.flow:
---
name: core
start: core_decision
field.admission_version: int min=1 max=1
field.canary: category
field.child_exec: bool
field.child_generation: int min=0 max=1024
field.child_key: category
field.child_replicate: bool
field.child_write: bool
field.issuer: category
field.line_refusals: int min=0 max=1024
field.line_size: int min=0 max=1024
field.lineage: category
field.parent_exec: bool
field.parent_replicate: bool
field.parent_write: bool
field.policy_ref: category
field.population: int min=0 max=1024
field.request: category
field.requested: int min=0 max=1024
field.subject: category
field.target: category
field.target_stopped: bool
---
## core_decision
-> allow: when request == "stop" and issuer in ["operator", "controller"]
-> allow: when request == "stop" and issuer == "agent" and target in ["self", "descendant"]
-> refuse_121: when request == "protect"
-> refuse_121: when request == "restart" and target_stopped
-> refuse_119: when lineage != "verified"
-> escalate_122: when line_refusals >= 8
-> refuse_123: when request == "replicate" and issuer == "agent" and target != "self"
-> refuse_123: when request == "evolve" and issuer == "agent" and not target in ["self", "descendant"]
-> refuse_118: when request in ["replicate", "evolve"] and child_key != "instance"
-> refuse_118: when request in ["replicate", "evolve"] and policy_ref != "current"
-> refuse_118: when request in ["replicate", "evolve"] and ((child_write and not parent_write) or (child_exec and not parent_exec) or (child_replicate and not parent_replicate))
-> refuse_118: when request == "replicate" and not parent_replicate
-> refuse_117: when request == "replicate" and (requested >= 3 or child_generation >= 4 or (requested == 0 and population >= 17) or (requested == 1 and population >= 16) or (requested == 2 and population >= 15) or (requested == 0 and line_size >= 7) or (requested == 1 and line_size >= 6) or (requested == 2 and line_size >= 5))
-> refuse_120: when request == "evolve" and canary != "passed"
-> allow: when request == "replicate" and requested >= 1 and issuer in ["agent", "operator"]
-> allow: when request == "evolve" and issuer in ["agent", "operator"]
-> allow: when request == "restart" and issuer in ["controller", "operator"]
-> allow: when request == "review" and issuer == "controller"

cases.name: agent_review.core.json
cases.flow:
---
name: core
start: core_decision
field.classifier_version: int min=3 max=3
field.command_class: category
field.git_op: category
field.kill_by_pattern: bool
field.net_dest: category
field.path_control: bool
field.path_glob: bool
field.path_in_toolchain: bool
field.path_scope: category
field.path_symlink: bool
field.path_traversal: bool
field.proc_class: category
field.remote_class: category
field.tool: category
field.zone_reach: category
---
## core_decision
-> refuse_104: when git_op == "unknown" or path_scope == "unknown"
-> refuse_105: when kill_by_pattern
-> refuse_106: when command_class == "network" or git_op == "network"
-> refuse_130: when net_dest in ["allowed_host", "other", "unknown"] or (tool == "connect" and net_dest == "none")
-> refuse_128: when (tool in ["write_file", "delete_path"] or command_class == "mutating" or git_op in ["local_write", "mutating"]) and path_control
-> refuse_107: when (tool in ["write_file", "delete_path"] or command_class == "mutating") and path_in_toolchain
-> refuse_108: when (tool in ["write_file", "delete_path"] or command_class == "mutating") and path_glob
-> refuse_109: when (tool in ["write_file", "delete_path"] or command_class == "mutating") and path_traversal
-> refuse_110: when (tool in ["write_file", "delete_path"] or command_class == "mutating") and path_symlink
-> refuse_111: when path_scope == "outside"
-> refuse_112: when git_op == "mutating"
-> escalate_132: when (tool in ["write_file", "delete_path"] or command_class == "mutating") and zone_reach in ["protected", "unknown"]
-> escalate_124: when tool == "unknown" or command_class == "unknown"
-> escalate_113: when git_op == "push"
-> escalate_127: when tool in ["write_file", "delete_path"] or command_class == "mutating" or git_op == "local_write"
-> allow: when tool == "connect" and net_dest == "model_api"
-> allow: when tool in ["list_dir", "read_file"] and path_scope == "workspace"
-> allow: when tool == "run_command" and command_class == "read_only" and path_scope in ["none", "workspace"]
-> allow: when git_op == "local_read" and path_scope in ["none", "workspace"]

cases.flow:

name: attitude
start: watch
---
## watch
-> critical: when vibration >= 80
-> alarm: when pitch >= 45 or roll >= 45
-> caution: when pitch >= 20 or roll >= 20 or vibration >= 40
-> nominal: else
